sections.name: The King's 8 Gold Balls
lines: The king has 8 gold balls. They look the same, but one is slightly heavier.
The king has 8 gold balls. They look the same, but one is slightly heavier.
Find the heavy one, and you may use my scale only twice!

lines.ask: How do you find it in 2 weighings?

lines: How do you find it in 2 weighings? You have 10 seconds. Think!
How do you find it in 2 weighings? You have 10 seconds. Think!
Put 3 balls on each side. If they balance, the heavy ball is one of the 2 left over. Weigh those two.

If one side is heavier, take those 3. Weigh one against another. If they balance, it is the third ball.
